name: Hyperliquid Spot Orderbook
description: Hyperliquid is a Layer 1 blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. The order book is fully onchain, and orders are matched in price-time priority. Every order, cancel, trade, and liquidation happens transparently.

methodology.Fees: Include spot trading fees, unit protocol fees, and HYPE burned in successful HIP-1 token-deployment auctions, excluding perps fees.
methodology.Revenue: 97% of spot trading fees before 30 Aug 2025 and 99% thereafter go to Assistance Fund for buying HYPE tokens, excluding unit protocol fees; HYPE paid in successful HIP-1 token-deployment auctions is burned.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 97% of spot trading fees before 30 Aug 2025 and 99% thereafter go to Assistance Fund for buying HYPE tokens, excluding unit protocol fees; HYPE paid in successful HIP-1 token-deployment auctions is permanently burned.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 1% of fees go to HLP Vault suppliers, before 30 Aug 2025 it was 3% + fees for unit protocol.

Fees.Spot Fees: Fees collected on all spot trades, excluding trades on markets with Unit assets (eg bridged BTC).
Fees.Spot fees on Unit markets: Fees from spot trades on markets that include an asset deployed by Unit, in these spot markets all fees go to Unit.
Fees.Spot Deployment Auction Burns: HYPE paid and permanently burned in successful HIP-1 token-deployment auctions.

Revenue.Spot Fees: 97% of spot trade fees before 30 Aug 2025 and 99% thereafter, excluding perp fees and unit protocol fees.
Revenue.Spot Deployment Auction Burns: HIP-1 token-deployment auction payments permanently burned rather than retained or distributed.

SupplySideRevenue.Unit Revenue: All fees earned on Unit spot markets go to Unit
SupplySideRevenue.HLP: 1% of the spot fees go to HLP vault (used to be 3% before 30 Aug 2025)

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: 97% of spot trade fees before 30 Aug 2025 and 99% thereafter, excluding perp fees and unit protocol fees, for buying back HYPE tokens.
HoldersRevenue.Spot Deployment Auction Burns: HYPE permanently removed from supply through successful HIP-1 token-deployment auctions.
